_source: Real slot-lane owner transactions, 2026-10-16/17: the signatures of the rabbit frame log (logs/memecoin_runner.log), fetched as getTransaction base64 (maxSupportedTransactionVersion 1) on the research Helius key. These are the wire bytes a Helius preconf frame carries after its 18-byte header. rabbit_verdict/rabbit_venue: what the rabbit frame line said about the same signature. fire_direct: the raw bytes of the rabbit stage-2 fixture's recorded direct buy_exact_sol_in (rabbit_curve_buys_20261016.json). dflow_pump_amm_v1: the raw bytes of the v1 entries of dflow_pump_amm_frames.json 'pure' (Beta's fixture), keyed the same.
